Candidate_B_Reaction_Mass_Ring_or_Surfac.name: Direct Reaction-Mass Propulsion on Earth / Octo-Earth Ring (v_e = 3,000 km/s Fusion/Ion)

Candidate_C_Pure_Photon_Beamed_Momentum.momentum_transfer_mechanism: Direct photon radiation pressure from laser/microwave beam without reaction mass
